task: Remove the "eu_customers" segment override of the flag "bulk_discounts" in Production. Keep the same override in Development.
finalText: DONE: I deleted the `eu_customers` segment override on `bulk_discounts` in Production. Production now has no segment overrides for that flag, and Development still has its `eu_customers` override (on, `segment_copy`). The `eu_customers` segment itself and the flag were not changed.
